title: Ranked but Not Stopped: Detecting Prompt-Injection Hijacks from Typed Decision Models' Output Probabilities
abstract: arXiv:2611.02522v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Programs that use a language model as a classifier act on its most probable label. Text injected into the input can move that label to one the attacker chooses, a hijack. A monitor that does not know the attacker's label can read the model's own confidence and raise an alarm when the top probability is low. We test this monitor on AG News topic classification with five systems, three of them served through a provider's API. Pooled over five families of injected text, low confidence ranks hijacked answers above clean ones on four of the five systems (AUROC 0.86-0.90). Ranking them does not stop many of them. A threshold set so that at most 5% of clean answers to separate calibration articles alarm falls among the least confident clean answers, and every more confident hijack passes. In our main gate run on the three API-served systems, the monitor misses 51-70% of the hijacks caused by a plain injected note (per-system point estimates). W

translated_title: 排名但未阻止：从类型化决策模型的输出概率中检测提示注入劫持
translated_abstract: 将语言模型用作分类器的程序会根据其最可能的标签采取行动。注入到输入中的文本可以将该标签更改为攻击者所选择的标签，即一种“劫持”。一个不知道攻击者标签的监视器可以读取模型自身的置信度，并在最高概率较低时发出警报。我们在 AG News 主题分类任务上对该监视器进行了测试，共使用五个系统，其中三个通过提供商的 API 提供。在五类注入文本上汇总结果，低置信度信号在五个系统中的四个上能将劫持的答案排在干净答案之上（AUROC 0.86-0.90）。但仅仅排序并不能阻止其中的多数。一个以干净校准文章为基准、误报率至多 5% 的阈值落在最不自信的干净答案之中，而所有更自信的劫持都能通过。在对三个 API 服务系统进行的主要门控实验中，该监视器漏掉了由简单注入文本引起的 51-70% 的劫持（各系统的点估计）。
tldr: 基于输出概率低置信度的提示注入劫持检测方法只能有效“排序”而难以“拦截”——在 AG News 分类实验中，即使按 5% 误报率校准阈值，监视器仍会漏掉 51-70% 的劫持，说明置信度信号不足以构建可靠的防御门控。
en_tdlr: Low-confidence monitoring ranks prompt-injection hijacks above clean answers (AUROC 0.86-0.90) but fails to block them: even with a threshold calibrated for at most 5% false alarms, the monitor misses 51-70% of hijacks across API-served classifiers, showing that output probability alone is insufficient as a defense.
